item.title: 7. Knoxville, Tennessee
item.description: Nestled in the Volunteer State’s Appalachian foothills, Knoxville upholds Southern conservative traditions, including strong faith communities, respect for the military, and opposition to big-government policies. It consistently delivers high Republican turnout while valuing fiscal responsibility and cultural heritage.
